disclaimer: Cross-lane protocol-neutrality matrix (P0.6C, model_identity closed P0.6D, litellm-sdk lane added P0.7A, pydantic-ai-agent lane added P0.7B). Derived from offline-mock evidence and code review against installed SDK/framework shapes and current schema behavior. It is implementation-shape evidence only, NOT live provider semantic evidence, and NOT the ALMS runtime contract. No live provider request was made during P0.6C/P0.6D/P0.7A/P0.7B; the LiteLLM Proxy Server was never started; and the Pydantic AI Gateway and Logfire were never used. The pydantic-ai-agent lane audits the PydanticAI Agent (Agent graph, FunctionModel offline seam, framework message/part model, NativeOutput, deferred tools, run_stream_events, RunUsage aggregation, model identity, framework terminal states/exceptions), NOT the Pydantic AI Gateway / Evals / Logfire / OpenTelemetry export; it was stress-tested against N-01..N-05 and does not reintroduce them. The litellm-sdk lane audits the LiteLLM Python SDK (litellm.completion), NOT the LiteLLM Proxy Server; it was stress-tested against N-01..N-05 and does not reintroduce them.

TOOL-001.package_boundary_dependency: litellm.completion(tools=...) imports proxy MCP utilities requiring fastapi, absent by design in this SDK-only probe (finding L-01)

pydantic-ai-agent.execution: offline_mock via real pydantic-ai-agent probe subprocess using PydanticAI's own FunctionModel seam (Agent surface; NOT the Pydantic AI Gateway); ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS=False before any Agent runs, network tripwire (loopback-only), instrumentation/Logfire/OpenTelemetry export off, no Gateway/endpoint, output+tool retries=0, request_limit=1; zero provider calls / network / credential / tool executions. The six fixtures do NOT all use an identical path (see execution_paths): non-stream fixtures run via agent.iter (graph + result); the stream fixture runs run_stream_events (framework events) plus a separate agent.iter (graph nodes).

findings.summary: results._usage_block hardcoded provenance=reported for all present usage, so LangChain framework-normalized usage_metadata was indistinguishable from provider-reported usage.

results._usage_block read only OpenAI-nested cache/reasoning paths, so Anthropic cache_creation/cache_read and LangChain input_token_details tokens were dropped to null in the result summary; the result schema had no cache-creation/cache-read split.

Native provider/framework terminal states (requires_action, incomplete, budget_exceeded, refusal, stop_reason, finish_reason) were preserved only inside the transcript and collapsed to PASS/PASS_WITH_EXTENSION at the result level, with no queryable native-terminal field.
No centrally-owned provenance vocabulary existed; provider-vs-framework and reported-vs-estimated distinctions were expressed only by scattered signals.

probe-response.model holds the requested/configured model id; the provider-returned served model was preserved only in the raw response artifact, with no first-class returned-model field. Closed offline in P0.6D: result.observed_model_identity now carries requested_model / observed_returned_model / observed_returned_model_source / observed_returned_model_raw_ref / execution_mode / model_identity_match, derived per-lane from raw evidence with no fabrication and no canonicalization. Real returned-vs-requested provider routing/alias/snapshot behavior stays unverified_until_live.

LiteLLM SDK tool path couples to MCP/proxy-oriented dependencies. Invoking the selected completion surface with tool configuration (litellm.completion(tools=...)) in the proxy-free isolated environment imports LiteLLM utilities that require FastAPI (a proxy-server dependency). Impact: the SDK-only lane cannot exercise the complete TOOL-001 completion path without introducing server-layer dependencies; request transformation (get_optional_params) and response representation (litellm ModelResponse tool-call types) remain testable separately, and are what the lane exercises for TOOL-001. Contract impact: no shared ALMS evidence contract failure was observed (no false provenance, no false semantic equivalence, no contract loss). Live status: the complete completion(tools=...) path, provider adapter translation, provider request creation, network exception mapping, and provider-returned tool semantics remain unverified_until_live. Not F1: no reproducible shared-contract loss or false provenance was found.
